subject: french
title: Adjective Agreement
welcome_lead: How French adjectives change for gender.
meta_desc: KS3 French: adjective agreement, masculine, feminine.
final_note: Adjectives must agree with the noun in French.

walkthroughs.body_html: In French, adjectives agree with the noun. If the noun is feminine, add -e to the adjective. If plural, add -s. Often both.
Un grand garcon (a tall boy — m). Une grande fille (a tall girl — f). Des grands garcons (tall boys — m pl).
Most adjectives come after the noun in French (un livre bleu = a blue book). A few common ones (grand, petit, beau, vieux) come before.
